dewbread.name: Dewbread
dewbread.desc: Bread baked from morning dew. Heals 15.

glowberry.name: Glowberry
glowberry.use_text: You eat the Glowberry. Your teeth glow for a second.

memory_tonic.name: Memory Tonic
memory_tonic.use_text: You drink the tonic and remember something nice.

brass_gear.name: Brass Gear
brass_gear.desc: Warm, as if it misses its clock.

lantern_charm.name: Lantern Charm
lantern_charm.desc: Mira's charm. It points toward home.

blank_page.name: Blank Page
blank_page.desc: Your name at the top. Nothing else. Yet.

burned_page.name: Burned Page
burned_page.desc: Half of your name, and a word: FILED.
